test_case.purpose: Sustain both sockets under approved load for 12 hours at measured low rails and validate signed per-socket power, frequency, thermal and RAS limits.
required_package: Pinned stress profile and load floors
Calibrated low-rail environment and abort limits
test_case.test_command: Operator establishes mapping/baseline, ramps to measured 40C/-5%, runs socket-affined workers for 12 hours and records per-socket load/frequency/power/thermal/throttle/RAS plus heartbeat/environment; compare only to signed oracle; restore nominal conditions.
test_case.expected_result: Both sockets sustain required load and approved power behavior for the full interval with no disallowed throttle/RAS/tool/BMC/stability fault; restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires dual-socket coverage, continuous low-rail trace and signed power oracle. Aggregate utilization, one socket, undefined max, +5% evidence or short stress cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified operator and independent rail/thermal telemetry
Abort on heartbeat, RAS, thermal/power or rail fault
Preserve evidence; restore nominal; no retry
test_case.recovery: Stop on CPU/environment fault, preserve synchronized evidence, use OOB, ramp to nominal, verify both sockets/system and do not automatically rerun.
